---
title: "Does the 714 mm flat plate design still miss the 50 g budget at the stall-bounded trim?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 120.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 200.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 56.3      # s the probe actually used

target_span, stall_angle, mass_budget_g = 0.714, 5.75, 50.0

sink_lib, opt_lib = optimize_geometry_library(
    get_airplane_plate, alpha_max=stall_angle, span_max=target_span
)
total_mass_g = opt_lib.m_total * 1000
ballast_mass_g = opt_lib.mass_ballast * 1000
airframe_mass_g = total_mass_g - ballast_mass_g
mass_excess_g = total_mass_g - mass_budget_g

area_density = 0.1744
foam_thickness = 0.005
vol_density = area_density / foam_thickness

m_wings_g = sum(w.area() * area_density for w in opt_lib.wings) * 1000
m_fuse_g = opt_lib.fuselages[0].volume() * vol_density * 1000
m_engines_g = sum(f.volume() * vol_density for f in opt_lib.fuselages if "Engine" in f.name) * 1000
m_guns_g = sum(f.volume() * vol_density for f in opt_lib.fuselages if "Gun" in f.name) * 1000

misses_budget = total_mass_g > mass_budget_g
misses_str = "Yes" if misses_budget else "No"

assert misses_budget
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{misses_str}, {total_mass_g:.1f} g"`]{.hero-value}
[all-up mass at stall-bounded trim]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Yes. At the [`{python} f"{stall_angle:.2f}°"`]{.key} [stall-bounded trim](2026-09-29-05-is-naca-0006-a-valid-flat-plate-proxy-at-the-stall-bounded-reynolds-nu.qmd), the optimized [714 mm flat plate design](2026-09-29-07-what-is-the-smallest-flat-plate-span-meeting-the-2-s-flight-time-targe.qmd) reaches an all-up mass of [`{python} f"{total_mass_g:.1f} g"`]{.key} under the [library mass model](2026-09-30-01-does-replacing-hand-rolled-mass-geometry-with-wing-area-and-fuselage-v.qmd), exceeding the [`{python} f"{mass_budget_g:.0f} g"`]{.key} [budget](../02-wings-at-rear/2026-09-29-01-does-it-meet-the-50-g-mass-budget-with-ballast-fitted.qmd) by [`{python} f"{mass_excess_g:.1f} g"`]{.key}. Because the aircraft trims at [`{python} f"{opt_lib.alpha_trim:.2f}°"`]{.key} without requiring nose ballast ([`{python} f"{ballast_mass_g:.1f} g"`]{.key}), the excess is entirely structural foam: the wide wings ([`{python} f"{m_wings_g:.1f} g"`]{.key}) and fuselage components account for the entire mass (@tbl-mass-breakdown).

```{python}
#| label: tbl-mass-breakdown
#| tbl-cap: "Component mass breakdown of the 714 mm flat plate design at stall-bounded trim."
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

header = ["Component", "Mass", "Share"]
rows = [
    ("Wings", f"{m_wings_g:.2f} g", f"{m_wings_g / total_mass_g * 100:.1f}%"),
    ("Fuselage", f"{m_fuse_g:.2f} g", f"{m_fuse_g / total_mass_g * 100:.1f}%"),
    ("Engines", f"{m_engines_g:.2f} g", f"{m_engines_g / total_mass_g * 100:.1f}%"),
    ("Cannons", f"{m_guns_g:.2f} g", f"{m_guns_g / total_mass_g * 100:.1f}%"),
    ("Ballast", f"{ballast_mass_g:.2f} g", f"{ballast_mass_g / total_mass_g * 100:.1f}%"),
    ("Total all-up", f"{total_mass_g:.2f} g", "100.0%"),
]
md_table(header, rows)
```
